message: Vector Rebel 3.2.56 automatically applies the selected SCBA locations in native Vector Filters.
releaseNotes: SCBA Airpacks still lets the operator choose any combination of Truck 504, Medic 504, and Station 4 SCBA Supply Room; Find SCBA Airpacks now opens Vector native Filters, selects only the requested available location checkboxes, applies them, and refuses to scan unless native filter chips prove an exact match. No duplicate manual filter-selection step. Draft-only SCBA review continues without any official inspection submit or signature.
